class.name: VECSWorld
class.brief_description:
The main entry point of VortarisECS: a Node wrapping one ECS world. Registered as the [code]VECS[/code] engine singleton.
VortarisECS 的主入口：一个封装单个 ECS 世界的节点，已注册为 [code]VECS[/code] 引擎单例。
class.description:
[b]VECSWorld[/b] is a [Node] that owns a single entity-component-system world and exposes it to GDScript. It is registered as the [code]VECS[/code] engine singleton, so scripts can call [code]VECS.get_world()[/code] to reach it.
Use it to create and destroy entities, register script-defined components, run queries, iterate over component sets, flush deferred structural changes, and serialize/deserialize the world. Script-defined (schema-only) components registered here behave identically to C++ components compiled into the extension.
Entities are referenced through lightweight [VECSEntity] handles. Component values are read and written through [VECSComponent] accessors, or with the convenience [method get_field] / [method set_field] / [method spawn] / [method each] sugar.
[b]VECSWorld[/b] 是一个 [Node]，拥有一个独立的实体-组件-系统世界并把接口暴露给 GDScript。它已注册为 [code]VECS[/code] 引擎单例，脚本通过 [code]VECS.get_world()[/code] 即可获取。
用它创建/销毁实体、注册脚本定义组件、执行查询、遍历组件集、冲刷延迟的结构性变更，以及序列化/反序列化整个世界。在此注册的脚本（仅 schema）组件与编译进扩展的 C++ 组件行为完全一致。
实体通过轻量的 [VECSEntity] 句柄引用；组件值通过 [VECSComponent] 访问器读写，或用便捷方法 [method get_field] / [method set_field] / [method spawn] / [method each]。

method.name: add_observer
method.description:
Registers [param observer] with this world. The observer starts receiving component events (ADDED / REMOVED / CHANGED / MATCHED / UNMATCHED / custom) according to its [member VECSObserver.events] mask and component filter.
向本世界注册 [param observer]。观察者将按其 [member VECSObserver.events] 掩码与组件过滤器开始接收组件事件（ADDED / REMOVED / CHANGED / MATCHED / UNMATCHED / 自定义）。

method.name: add_system
method.description:
Registers [param system] for execution. The system joins its [member VECSSystem.group]; call [method process] with that group to tick it. On registration the system's [code]_setup[/code] hook runs so it can build cached views against this world.
注册 [param system] 以便执行。系统加入其 [member VECSSystem.group] 分组；用该分组名调用 [method process] 驱动它。注册时会运行系统的 [code]_setup[/code] 钩子，以便它针对本世界构建缓存视图。

method.name: commands
method.description:
Returns the world's shared [VECSCommandBuffer]. Structural changes (add/remove component, destroy entity) issued inside an iteration must be deferred through this buffer and flushed once with [method VECSCommandBuffer.flush]. All handles returned by this method share the same underlying world-level buffer.
返回世界共享的 [VECSCommandBuffer]。迭代内发起的结构性变更（增删组件、销毁实体）必须经此缓冲延迟，并用 [method VECSCommandBuffer.flush] 一次性应用。该方法返回的所有句柄共享同一个世界级缓冲。

method.name: compact
method.description:
Frees archetypes that no longer hold any entity and reclaims their memory. Safe to call periodically (e.g. after scene transitions) if many component sets have emptied out.
释放已不含任何实体的 archetype 并回收内存。若大量组件集已清空，可周期性调用（例如场景切换后）。

method.name: copy_entity_to
method.description:
Copies [param entity] (every component, with field values) from the world it belongs to into [param target]. The target keeps the source id when its slot is free, otherwise a fresh id is assigned. Returns [code]{source_id: target_id}[/code]. Copying into the same world clones the entity (buffered through the command buffer).
把 [param entity]（全部组件及其字段值）从它所属的世界复制到 [param target]。目标世界在槽位空闲时保留源 id，否则分配新 id。返回 [code]{source_id: target_id}[/code]。复制到同一世界会克隆该实体（经命令缓冲提交）。

method.name: create_entity
method.description:
Creates a new entity with no components and returns a handle to it. Components can then be added with [method VECSEntity.add_component] or via the convenience [method spawn].
创建一个不含组件的实体并返回其句柄。之后可用 [method VECSEntity.add_component] 或便捷方法 [method spawn] 添加组件。

method.name: create_entity_pooled
method.description:
Creates an entity, reusing a slot reclaimed by [method destroy_entity_pooled] when one is available. Pooled recycling does NOT bump the id generation, so a stale handle captured before the pooled destroy stays valid if the slot is reused (documented trade-off). Pooled slots are never handed out by the regular allocators.
创建实体；若有 [method destroy_entity_pooled] 回收的槽位则复用。池化回收不 bump id 代数，因此在池化销毁前捕获的过期句柄在槽位复用后仍然有效（文档注明的取舍）。池化槽位不会被常规分配器发出。

method.name: create_entity_preassigned
method.description:
Creates an entity with an explicit id (slot + generation packed into the 64-bit value). Used by snapshot loading and network replication so ids stay stable across worlds. Returns a null handle if the id is invalid or the slot is already occupied.
以显式 id（槽位 + 代数打包进 64 位值）创建实体。快照加载与网络复制用它保证 id 跨世界稳定。若 id 无效或槽位已被占用则返回空句柄。

method.name: deserialize_snapshot
method.description:
Loads a binary snapshot produced by [method serialize_snapshot] into this world. Loading replaces the existing world contents. Returns [code]true[/code] on success, [code]false[/code] on a version mismatch or malformed data.
把 [method serialize_snapshot] 生成的二进制快照载入本世界。加载会替换现有世界内容。成功返回 [code]true[/code]，版本不匹配或数据损坏返回 [code]false[/code]。

method.name: deserialize_snapshot_json
method.description:
Loads a JSON save produced by [method serialize_snapshot_json]. Accepts either an already-parsed [Dictionary] or a JSON [String]. Loading replaces the existing world contents; unknown components are skipped with a warning, entity ids are preserved. Returns [code]true[/code] only if every entity spawned.
载入 [method serialize_snapshot_json] 生成的 JSON 存档。接受已解析的 [Dictionary] 或 JSON [String]。加载会替换现有世界内容；未知组件跳过并告警，实体 id 保留。仅当所有实体都成功生成时才返回 [code]true[/code]。

method.name: deserialize_snapshot_json_mapped
method.description:
Like [method deserialize_snapshot_json], but returns the id mapping produced by [method spawn_from_data_mapped] ([code]{source_id_or_index: new_id}[/code]) instead of a bool. Loading replaces the world first; the mapping lets you rewrite cross-entity references with [method remap_reference]. Returns an empty [Dictionary] on malformed data.
类似 [method deserialize_snapshot_json]，但返回 [method spawn_from_data_mapped] 产生的 id 映射（[code]{source_id_or_index: new_id}[/code]）而非 bool。加载先替换世界；映射可用于 [method remap_reference] 改写跨实体引用。数据损坏返回空 [Dictionary]。

method.name: destroy_entity
method.description:
Destroys [param entity] immediately (not deferred). Dispatching a REMOVED event for each of its components. No-op if the entity is already dead. To destroy inside an iteration, use [method VECSCommandBuffer.remove_entity] instead.
立即销毁 [param entity]（非延迟），并为其每个组件派发 REMOVED 事件。若实体已销毁则为空操作。若要在迭代内销毁，请改用 [method VECSCommandBuffer.remove_entity]。

method.name: destroy_entity_pooled
method.description:
Destroys [param entity] and reclaims its id for [method create_entity_pooled], WITHOUT bumping the id generation. The slot is reserved for pooled reuse and never handed out by the regular allocators, so a stale handle stays valid after a pooled reuse. Dispatches a REMOVED event per component.
销毁 [param entity] 并把其 id 回收给 [method create_entity_pooled]，且不 bump id 代数。槽位保留给池化复用，不会由常规分配器发出，因此池化复用后过期句柄仍有效。按组件派发 REMOVED 事件。

method.name: each
method.description:
Calls [param callable] once per entity that has every component named in [param components] (e.g. [code]["Position", "Velocity"][/code]). Unlike [method query].execute, no [Array] is materialized — suitable for iterating large populations. The callable receives the entity as a [VECSEntity]. Do not perform structural changes inside the callable.
对每个拥有 [param components] 中全部组件的实体调用一次 [param callable]（例如 [code]["Position", "Velocity"][/code]）。与 [method query].execute 不同，它不会物化 [Array]——适合遍历大规模实体。回调会收到 [VECSEntity] 实体。不要在回调内做结构性变更。

method.name: emit_event
method.description:
Broadcasts a custom event to observers that subscribe to [code]name[/code]. [param payload] is passed through unchanged; [param entity] may be a null handle for events that do not concern a specific entity. Returns the number of observer callbacks that received the event.
向订阅了 [code]name[/code] 的观察者广播自定义事件。[param payload] 原样传递；与特定实体无关的事件，[param entity] 可为空句柄。返回实际接收到该事件的观察者回调数量。

method.name: entities_to_data
method.description:
Exports entities as an [Array] of dictionaries of the form [code][{"id": int, "components": {"Name": {field: value}}}, ...][/code], in deterministic order (archetypes sorted by signature). Inverse of [method spawn_from_data]. [param max_entities] caps the export (0 = no limit): the editor's remote monitor passes it so a huge world stays bounded, while save-file serialization calls it without a cap and always exports every entity. Prefer the binary [method serialize_snapshot] for large worlds.
把实体导出为 [code][{"id": int, "components": {"Name": {field: value}}}, ...][/code] 形式的字典 [Array]，顺序确定（archetype 按签名排序）。是 [method spawn_from_data] 的逆操作。[param max_entities] 限制导出条数（0 = 不限制）：编辑器的远程监视器传入它，使大型世界保持有界；存档序列化则不带上限调用，始终导出全部实体。大型世界请优先用二进制 [method serialize_snapshot]。

method.name: entity
method.description:
Looks up a live entity by its raw 64-bit id. Returns a null handle when [param id] is not a live entity in this world (dead, recycled, or [code]<= 0[/code]).
按原始 64 位 id 查找存活实体。若 [param id] 在本世界中不是存活实体（已销毁、已回收或 [code]<= 0[/code]）则返回空句柄。

method.name: entity_count
method.description:
Returns the number of live entities in the world.
返回世界中存活的实体数量。

method.name: find_by_components
method.description:
Convenience sugar: returns the first entity that carries every component named in [param components], or a null handle if none match. Equivalent to [code]query().with_all(components).execute_one()[/code].
便捷语法：返回拥有 [param components] 中全部组件的第一个实体，无匹配则返回空句柄。等价于 [code]query().with_all(components).execute_one()[/code]。

method.name: get_component_type
method.description:
Returns metadata for the component type registered as [param name], or a null handle if it is not registered. The returned [VECSComponentType] exposes field names, sizes and sync priorities.
返回注册名为 [param name] 的组件类型的元数据；未注册则返回空句柄。返回的 [VECSComponentType] 暴露字段名、大小与同步优先级。

method.name: get_debug_stats
method.description:
Returns a [Dictionary] of world statistics for tooling and the editor inspector: [code]entity_count[/code], [code]archetype_count[/code], [code]component_count[/code], [code]observer_count[/code], [code]change_tick[/code], [code]pool_size[/code] and [code]query_cache_entries[/code].
返回供工具与编辑器检查器使用的一个 [Dictionary] 世界统计：[code]entity_count[/code]、[code]archetype_count[/code]、[code]component_count[/code]、[code]observer_count[/code]、[code]change_tick[/code]、[code]pool_size[/code] 与 [code]query_cache_entries[/code]。

method.name: get_field
method.description:
Convenience sugar for [method VECSEntity.getf]: reads a single field of a component on [param entity]. Returns [param default] (a null [Variant] by default) if the component or field does not exist.
[method VECSEntity.getf] 的便捷语法：读取 [param entity] 上某个组件的单个字段。若组件或字段不存在则返回 [param default]（默认是空 [Variant]）。

method.name: get_snapshot_data
method.description:
Returns a JSON-able [Dictionary] describing the whole world for the editor's remote ECS monitor: [code]{"protocol", "version", "stats", "components", "systems", "entities"}[/code]. [code]stats[/code] is the same dictionary as [method get_debug_stats]; [code]components[/code] lists every registered component type (name, id, size, and a [code]fields[/code] array of name/type/count/sync_priority/networked); [code]systems[/code] lists every registered system (name/group/active/paused/tick_interval/flush_mode); [code]entities[/code] is the same data as [method entities_to_data], capped at [code]vortarisecs/general/max_snapshot_entities[/code] (default 500) so a huge world does not serialize megabytes per auto-refresh tick — when the cap cuts the list the dictionary also carries [code]"truncated": true[/code] and [code]"entity_total"[/code] (the real world count). The game-side message capture sends this to the editor over the EngineDebugger channel (prefix [code]"vecs"[/code]) on demand. Building the full entity table every frame is expensive, so request it on demand (see the editor's "ECS" debugger tab).
返回一个可 JSON 化的 [Dictionary]，用于编辑器的远程 ECS 监视器，描述整个世界：[code]{"protocol", "version", "stats", "components", "systems", "entities"}[/code]。[code]stats[/code] 与 [method get_debug_stats] 相同；[code]components[/code] 列出每个已注册组件类型（name、id、size，以及 [code]fields[/code] 数组，含 name/type/count/sync_priority/networked）；[code]systems[/code] 列出每个已注册系统（name/group/active/paused/tick_interval/flush_mode）；[code]entities[/code] 与 [method entities_to_data] 相同，但按 [code]vortarisecs/general/max_snapshot_entities[/code]（默认 500）截断，避免大世界每次自动刷新都序列化出 MB 级数据——截断发生时字典额外带有 [code]"truncated": true[/code] 与 [code]"entity_total"[/code]（真实实体总数）。游戏侧消息捕获经 EngineDebugger 通道（前缀 [code]"vecs"[/code]）按需发送给编辑器。每帧构建完整实体表代价高昂，请按需请求（见编辑器 “ECS” 调试选项卡）。

method.name: debug_set_field
method.description:
Runtime-debug write: validates that the entity is alive, the component is attached, the field exists AND that [param value]'s Variant type matches the field's expected type, then applies it through the same schema-driven conversion as [method VECSComponent.set_field]. A type mismatch is rejected with [code]{"ok": false, "error": "type mismatch ..."}[/code] instead of being silently coerced to a zero value by Godot's Variant-to-type conversion. Returns [code]{"ok": bool, "error": String}[/code]; [code]error[/code] is empty on success. This is the game-side handler behind the editor's "ECS" debugger tab live value editing (channel [code]"vecs:set_field"[/code]); it performs no structural changes and is safe to call on a running world.
运行时调试写入：校验实体存活、组件已挂载、字段存在，且 [param value] 的 Variant 类型与字段期望类型一致，然后通过与 [method VECSComponent.set_field] 相同的 schema 驱动转换应用该值。类型不匹配时返回 [code]{"ok": false, "error": "type mismatch ..."}[/code]，而不是被 Godot 的 Variant→类型转换静默地写成零值。返回 [code]{"ok": bool, "error": String}[/code]；成功时 [code]error[/code] 为空。这是编辑器 “ECS” 调试选项卡实时改值（通道 [code]"vecs:set_field"[/code]）背后的游戏侧处理；它不进行任何结构性修改，可安全地在运行中的世界上调用。

method.name: get_world
method.description:
Returns this node. Provided so systems and scripts can reach the world through a consistent accessor.
返回本节点。供系统与脚本通过一致的访问器获取世界。

method.name: has_entity
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] when an entity with the raw 64-bit [param id] is alive in this world. [code]false[/code] for a dead, recycled, or non-positive id.
当本世界中存在 id 为原始 64 位 [param id] 的存活实体时返回 [code]true[/code]。对已销毁、已回收或非正 id 返回 [code]false[/code]。

method.name: is_alive
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if [param entity] refers to a live entity in this world. Stale handles (from a destroyed or recycled entity) return [code]false[/code].
若 [param entity] 指向本世界中的一个存活实体则返回 [code]true[/code]。过期句柄（来自已销毁或已回收的实体）返回 [code]false[/code]。

method.name: merge_world
method.description:
Merges every entity of [param source] into this world, returning the total [code]{source_id: target_id}[/code] mapping (see [method copy_entity_to]). Passing this world as [param source] clones it. Entities whose ids conflict in the target get fresh ids; the mapping records the correspondence.
把 [param source] 的所有实体合并到本世界，返回总 [code]{source_id: target_id}[/code] 映射（见 [method copy_entity_to]）。把本世界作为 [param source] 传入即克隆自身。在目标中 id 冲突的实体获得新 id；映射记录对应关系。

method.name: off
method.description:
Unsubscribes a field subscription created by [method on_field_changed].
注销由 [method on_field_changed] 创建的字段订阅。

method.name: on_field_changed
method.description:
Subscribes to value changes of one component field. The callback [code]callable(entity, value)[/code] fires only when the field actually changed value since the last delivery (a write of the same value does not fire). Returns a subscription id usable with [method off].
订阅单个组件字段的值变化。仅当字段自上次派发以来真正改变值时，回调 [code]callable(entity, value)[/code] 才触发（写入相同值不触发）。返回可用 [method off] 注销的订阅 id。

method.name: pool_size
method.description:
Returns the number of entity ids currently sitting in the pool, awaiting reuse by [method create_entity_pooled].
返回当前位于池中、等待 [method create_entity_pooled] 复用的实体 id 数量。

method.name: process
method.description:
Ticks every registered system in [param group] with [param delta] seconds. Call this once per frame (or at a fixed timestep) for each group of systems you run.
以 [param delta] 秒驱动 [param group] 分组中所有已注册系统。每帧（或固定时间步）为每个系统分组调用一次。

method.name: query
method.description:
Returns a new fluent query builder. Chain [method VECSQueryBuilder.with_all], [method VECSQueryBuilder.with_any], [method VECSQueryBuilder.with_none], [method VECSQueryBuilder.changed] and [method VECSQueryBuilder.enabled], then terminate with [method VECSQueryBuilder.execute] / [method VECSQueryBuilder.execute_one] / [method VECSQueryBuilder.count].
返回新的链式查询构建器。链式调用 [method VECSQueryBuilder.with_all]、[method VECSQueryBuilder.with_any]、[method VECSQueryBuilder.with_none]、[method VECSQueryBuilder.changed] 与 [method VECSQueryBuilder.enabled]，最后用 [method VECSQueryBuilder.execute] / [method VECSQueryBuilder.execute_one] / [method VECSQueryBuilder.count] 结束。

method.name: register_component
method.description:
Registers a script-defined (schema-only) component. [param fields] is an [Array] of dictionaries, each with a [code]name[/code] and a [code]type[/code] (one of [code]Bool[/code], [code]I8[/code]..[code]I64[/code], [code]U8[/code]..[code]U64[/code], [code]F32[/code]/[code]F64[/code], [code]Vector2[/code]..[code]Vector4[/code]([code]i[/code]), [code]Color[/code], [code]Quaternion[/code], [code]Basis[/code], [code]Transform2D[/code]/[code]3D[/code], [code]AABB[/code], [code]Rect2[/code], [code]Plane[/code], [code]StringFixed[/code], [code]Blob[/code]) and optional keys [code]count[/code], [code]sync_priority[/code] and [code]networked[/code]. Returns [code]false[/code] if a field is malformed or the name is already registered.
注册脚本定义（仅 schema）组件。[param fields] 是字典的 [Array]，每个字典含 [code]name[/code] 与 [code]type[/code]（类型为 [code]Bool[/code]、[code]I8[/code]..[code]I64[/code]、[code]U8[/code]..[code]U64[/code]、[code]F32[/code]/[code]F64[/code]、[code]Vector2[/code]..[code]Vector4[/code]([code]i[/code])、[code]Color[/code]、[code]Quaternion[/code]、[code]Basis[/code]、[code]Transform2D[/code]/[code]3D[/code]、[code]AABB[/code]、[code]Rect2[/code]、[code]Plane[/code]、[code]StringFixed[/code]、[code]Blob[/code] 之一），可选键为 [code]count[/code]、[code]sync_priority[/code] 与 [code]networked[/code]。若字段非法或名字已注册则返回 [code]false[/code]。

method.name: register_components
method.description:
Batch-registers several schema components at once: [code]{"Name": [{name, type, ...}, ...], ...}[/code]. Convenient for loading data tables (e.g. cards, items).
一次批量注册多个 schema 组件：[code]{"Name": [{name, type, ...}, ...], ...}[/code]。适合加载数据表（例如卡牌、物品）。

method.name: remap_reference
method.description:
Rewrites a component field that stores a source entity id: reads [code]entity.comp.field[/code] as an int, looks it up in [param map] (from [method spawn_from_data_mapped] / [method deserialize_snapshot_json_mapped]), and writes the mapped new id back. No-op when the field is missing, not numeric, or not present in the map.
改写存储源实体 id 的组件字段：把 [code]entity.comp.field[/code] 当作 int 读取，在 [param map]（来自 [method spawn_from_data_mapped] / [method deserialize_snapshot_json_mapped]）中查找，并写回映射后的新 id。字段缺失、非数值或不在映射中则为空操作。

method.name: remove_observer
method.description:
Unregisters [param observer] so it stops receiving events.
注销 [param observer]，使其停止接收事件。

method.name: remove_system
method.description:
Unregisters [param system] so it is no longer ticked.
注销 [param system]，使其不再被驱动。

method.name: serialize_snapshot
method.description:
Serializes the whole world to a deterministic binary snapshot (little-endian, fixed-width, byte-identical across runs). Load with [method deserialize_snapshot].
把整个世界序列化为确定性二进制快照（小端、定宽、跨运行逐字节一致）。用 [method deserialize_snapshot] 载入。

method.name: serialize_snapshot_json
method.description:
Serializes the whole world as a JSON-able [Dictionary]: [code]{"version": int, "entities": [...]}[/code]. Pass it to [method JSON.stringify] to write a save file.
把整个世界序列化为可 JSON 化的 [Dictionary]：[code]{"version": int, "entities": [...]}[/code]。把它传给 [method JSON.stringify] 即可写出存档文件。

method.name: serialize_snapshot_json_string
method.description:
Serializes the whole world as a JSON [String] ready to write to a save file. Honors the [code]vortarisecs/serialization/compact_json[/code] project setting: [code]true[/code] writes compact (unindented) JSON, [code]false[/code] writes pretty-printed JSON with tab indentation.
把整个世界序列化为可直接写入存档文件的 JSON [String]。遵循 [code]vortarisecs/serialization/compact_json[/code] 项目设置：[code]true[/code] 输出紧凑（无缩进）JSON，[code]false[/code] 输出带制表符缩进的格式化 JSON。

method.name: is_verbose
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] when detailed verbose logging is active for this process (debug build AND the [code]vortarisecs/general/verbose[/code] project setting, which falls back to the legacy [code]vortarisecs/verbose[/code] path from 0.3.0). Reading this also re-syncs the internal logging cache with the persisted setting, so the reported state always agrees with what the verbose logs actually emit (a direct [method ProjectSettings.set_setting] write is picked up here). In release builds this always returns [code]false[/code].
返回当前进程是否启用了详细 verbose 日志（debug 构建且 [code]vortarisecs/general/verbose[/code] 项目设置为真，并回退兼容 0.3.0 的旧 [code]vortarisecs/verbose[/code] 路径）。读取该方法还会把内部日志缓存与持久化设置重新同步，因此报告的状态始终与 verbose 日志实际输出一致（此处会捕获直接调用 [method ProjectSettings.set_setting] 的写入）。release 构建恒返回 [code]false[/code]。

method.name: set_entity_range
method.description:
Pre-reserves entity id slots up to [param base] so later ids stay within a range. Useful when combining network-assigned ids with locally-created ones. Out-of-range values are rejected.
预保留最多 [param base] 个实体 id 槽位，使之后的 id 保持在范围内。当网络分配的 id 与本地创建的 id 混用时有用。超出范围的值会被拒绝。

method.name: set_field
method.description:
Convenience sugar for [method VECSEntity.setf]: writes a single field of a component on [param entity] and marks it changed. No-op if the component or field does not exist.
[method VECSEntity.setf] 的便捷语法：写入 [param entity] 上某个组件的单个字段并标记为已变更。若组件或字段不存在则为空操作。

method.name: set_verbose
method.description:
Enables or disables detailed verbose logging for this process. Also writes the [code]vortarisecs/general/verbose[/code] project setting so the runtime toggle and the persisted setting stay in sync. Verbose logs are only emitted in debug builds; in release builds this is a no-op. See also [method is_verbose].
开启或关闭当前进程的详细 verbose 日志，同时写入 [code]vortarisecs/general/verbose[/code] 项目设置，使运行时开关与持久化设置保持一致。verbose 日志仅在 debug 构建中输出；release 构建中此方法为空操作。另见 [method is_verbose]。

method.name: shutdown
method.description:
Tears down transient state so the world can be reused or the extension can shut down cleanly: resets the core world (deferred ops, change baselines, command buffer, custom commands), clears the observer dispatch and the system scheduler. Existing entities and archetypes are preserved. Called automatically when the engine singleton is unloaded.
清理瞬态状态以便世界可复用或扩展可干净退出：重置核心世界（延迟操作、变更基线、命令缓冲、自定义命令）、清空观察者派发与系统调度器。已有实体与 archetype 保留。引擎单例卸载时自动调用。

method.name: spawn
method.description:
Convenience sugar: creates an entity and adds every component in [param components] in one call, e.g. [code]spawn({"Position": {"x": 1.0}, "Velocity": {"x": 0.5}})[/code]. Returns a handle to the new entity, or a null handle if spawning failed.
便捷语法：一次调用创建实体并添加 [param components] 中的所有组件，例如 [code]spawn({"Position": {"x": 1.0}, "Velocity": {"x": 0.5}})[/code]。返回新实体句柄；生成失败则返回空句柄。

method.name: spawn_from_data
method.description:
Batch-creates entities from data: [code][{"id"?: int, "parent"?: int, "components": {"Name": {field: value}}}, ...][/code]. Entities that fail to spawn (e.g. an id conflict) are skipped. Returns the array of created [VECSEntity] handles.
An entry may carry a [code]parent[/code] key whose value is the source id or array index of another entity in the same batch; after the batch, the child's field literally named [code]parent[/code] (on any of its components) is automatically rewritten to the freshly assigned parent id.
从数据批量创建实体：[code][{"id"?: int, "parent"?: int, "components": {"Name": {field: value}}}, ...][/code]。生成失败的实体（例如 id 冲突）会被跳过。返回创建出的 [VECSEntity] 句柄数组。
条目可带 [code]parent[/code] 键，值为同批另一实体的源 id 或数组下标；批量结束后，子实体上字段名为 [code]parent[/code]（在其任一组件上）的引用会自动改写为新建父实体的 id。

method.name: spawn_from_data_mapped
method.description:
Like [method spawn_from_data], but also returns an id mapping [code]{source_id_or_index: new_id}[/code]. Entries that carry an explicit [code]id[/code] are keyed by that id; entries without one are keyed by their array index. Pass the mapping to [method remap_reference] to rewrite cross-entity references after the batch.
类似 [method spawn_from_data]，但额外返回 id 映射 [code]{source_id_or_index: new_id}[/code]。带显式 [code]id[/code] 的条目以该 id 为键；无 id 的条目以数组下标为键。把映射传给 [method remap_reference] 可在批量后改写跨实体引用。

method.name: subscribe_event
method.description:
Subscribes to custom events with the given [param name]. The callback [code]callable(entity, payload)[/code] runs for every matching event broadcast with [method emit_event]. Returns a subscription id usable with [method unsubscribe_event].
订阅名为 [param name] 的自定义事件。每次 [method emit_event] 广播匹配事件时，回调 [code]callable(entity, payload)[/code] 都会执行。返回可用 [method unsubscribe_event] 注销的订阅 id。

method.name: system_count
method.description:
Returns the number of registered systems.
返回已注册系统的数量。

method.name: unsubscribe_event
method.description:
Unsubscribes a custom-event subscription created by [method subscribe_event].
注销由 [method subscribe_event] 创建的自定义事件订阅。
